101-719-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-719-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

880-6763-8338.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-8338.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1661-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2281-3817-3899.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-4556-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-4556-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Blight Mound triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2438-2946-4871-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2438-2946-4871-6026.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

3990-4091-7791.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Incubation Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

4153-4873-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
4153-4873-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4153-4873-6758.description:
Declare a creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to itself.
Dawnsire dies as a state-based action, triggering Resourceful Defense, putting at least twenty charge counters on Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.
4153-4873-6758.notes: You can instead use Resourceful Defense's activated ability to move the counters. This adds {4}{W} to the mana cost, but negates the need to attack.

413-772-891.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1558-3257-3875-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3257-3875-4231-4365.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1903-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1903-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1903-3259-3263-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1169-1563-2457-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1603-5282-7149.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Evil Twin dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Evil Twin enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Evil Twin leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Evil Twin from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: was foretold on a previous turn

1693-3750-6999.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
1693-3750-6999.description:
Cast Sozin's Comet either from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}.
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Leyline Tyrant.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
1693-3750-6999.notes:
You can attack with multiple creatures to get infinite red mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you can kill Hellkite Tyrant and pay mana to deal infinite damage to any target.

4598-5195-6991.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Donnie & April
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Donnie & April
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2919-4186-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-6458.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3703-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3703-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

198-2100-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {R} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Searing Touch.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

2079-2615-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2079-2615-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

2084-4393.description:
Cast Dance of Many by paying {U}{U}.
When Dance of Many enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token's ability by paying {1}{U}, causing you to shuffle the token into your library and mill all cards from your library.

856-2279-2921-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2279-2921-4321.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3525-6266.easyPrerequisites:
Redshift, Rocketeer Chief does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Redshift.
3525-6266.description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Redshift.
Repeat.

3652-4050-4763-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {W}.
When Ornithopter dies, Koll triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2292-2523-5401.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

654-1479-4288-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-4288-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

277-1170-1645-2397-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-4053-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
955-4053-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

423-3257-3609-4011.notablePrerequisites:
Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
You are able to play a number of lands this turn equal to four minus the number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
423-3257-3609-4011.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Evolution Sage trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat from step 1 until Magistrate's Scepter has four or more charge counters on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

168-372-2719.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-372-2719.description:
Cast Sakashima of a Thousand Faces either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Oblivion Ring returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

90-628-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 1 until Workhorse does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Workhorse's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1475-2034-4802.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
1475-2034-4802.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding {C}{C}.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power that each enter with at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2493-3742-4377.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2493-3742-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer that is tapped and attacking.
Archaeomancer enters, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2493-3632-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
